title: Stalk surjectivity of canonical Picard base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $E$ be finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], $g:T\to S$, and assume $R(f,E,g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Let $h:T'\to T$, $t\in T'$, and $F=E$ or $F=E^\vee$. Set $p=\operatorname{pr}_2:X\times_S T\to T$, $q=\operatorname{pr}_1:X\times_S T\to X$, and $p',v$ the two projections of $(X\times_S T)\times_T T'$. Put $P=h^*p_*q^*F$ and $Q=p'_*v^*q^*F$. Use the module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and the canonical ordinary map $\beta:P\to Q$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-base-change-map-open-restriction]. The induced linear map $\beta_t:P_t\to Q_t$ is surjective. Neither injectivity nor invertibility is asserted.

proof.text: Over a common-rank neighbourhood the proper flat finite-presentation morphism has perfect derived direct images for E and its dual, with arbitrary canonical derived base change. Their Tor amplitude starts at zero because every base-changed direct image has no negative cohomology.

Use residue-field tests of the universal rank condition and the residue-model construction of the lowest-cohomology locus. The first term has rank r and all negative terms vanish. The universal condition makes the outgoing degree-zero matrix zero. Scalar extension of H^0 and H^0 after scalar extension are then the same first free term; the natural comparison is the identity, hence surjective.

Identify this specific comparison with the adjoint-defined ordinary base-change map: transpose under tensor pullback adjoint to pushforward and use naturality and triangle identities. The result is exactly the unit, pushforward composition and square-commutation composite in moduleBaseChangeMap, with pullback associativity comparisons.

Open restriction of the canonical map agrees with the restricted square map. Taking the stalk at t turns the local identity calculation into surjectivity of beta_t for either F. Rank zero and empty bases introduce no exception.

theorem picardRankMatch_baseChange_stalk_surjective {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S)
    (hR : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g) {T' : Scheme.{u}} (h : T' ⟶ T)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : F = E ∨ F = Modules.dual E) (t : T') :
    Function.Surjective
      ((Modules.moduleBaseChangeMap (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h) h (pullback.fst (pullback.snd f g) h)
        pullback.condition ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)).stalkLinearMap t)
